page.overview:
What is Scatterbug?

Scatterbug is a small, worm-like Pokémon. Its skin is black, except around its neck. It does not grow in size when evolved into a Spewpa. It has strong resemblance to Caterpie by body style.

Scatterbug evolves into Spewpa starting at level 9 and then evolves into Vivillon starting at level 12.

Scatterbug is based on a tapestry moth caterpillar.

Scatterbug comes from scatter, caterpillar, and bug.
